sentences.en: Garlic and onion are good remedies against the common cold.
sentences.zh: 大蒜和洋葱是治疗普通感冒的好药方。

sentences.en: You shouldn't eat garlic before going out on a date.
sentences.zh: 在约会前你不应该吃大蒜。

sentences.en: Taste the soup to see if it needs more garlic.
sentences.zh: 尝一尝汤的味道，看看是否需要再加一些大蒜。

senses.zh: 大蒜；大蒜头；用于有相似气味的植物名中
